Name: MisoMegu's Dango Junimos
Author: MisoMegu
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/oyiWhvc.png[/img]
[center][size=4]﻿─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

My third mod now!
This one turns Junimo into the adorable dango that is inspired by Clannad!
I'm personally obsessed with how cute dango are and just watching the Junimo move around reminded me of the big dango family!
This was just a quick and easy mod to code and draw so I don't expect any errors or conflicts since it only replaces the Junimo art but of course, as always I am open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else!

﻿─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Current version 1.0.0
Compatible with 1.6
Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission!
